INVESTMENT POLICY OF EXAMPLE INDEPENDENT SCHOOL DISTRICT

Adoption. This written investment policy was adopted by resolution of the Board of
Trustees on September 1, 2025.

Objectives. The primary objectives, in order of priority, are preservation and safety of
principal, liquidity, and yield.

Authorized investments. The following investments are authorized, and investments not
listed are not authorized: obligations of the United States and its agencies, certificates
of deposit issued by a depository institution that has its main office or a branch office
in this state and insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, eligible
investment pools continuously rated no lower than AAA-m, and corporate bonds.

Corporate bonds. Corporate bonds rated A- or better at the time of purchase are
authorized, with a stated final maturity not later than five years from the date of
purchase. Corporate bond holdings shall not exceed 20 percent of the monthly average fund
balance, and not more than 40 percent of corporate bond holdings shall be invested in any
one domestic business entity. The Investment Officer will review ratings quarterly.

Settlement. All securities transactions, other than investment pool funds and mutual
funds, shall be settled on a delivery versus payment basis.

Maturity. The maximum stated maturity of any individual investment is 36 months. For
pooled fund groups, the maximum dollar-weighted average maturity allowed, based on the
stated maturity date for the portfolio, is 180 days.

Review. The Board of Trustees shall review this investment policy and the investment
strategies not less than annually and shall adopt a written instrument stating that it has
reviewed the investment policy and investment strategies and shall record any changes.
